rule: ERRO CONHECIDO -> REUTILIZAR; PADRAO NOVO -> MEDIR -> CONTRAPROVAR -> CRISTALIZAR; RUNTIME -> SOMENTE QUANDO APLICAVEL E PROVADO

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Dependabot branch carries the dependency bump while main may advance around it.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: The dependency bump is the useful delta for manifest conflict.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: Package manifest keeps the Dependabot bump from the PR branch.
patterns.COUNTERPROOF: resolve-conflicts-policy.test.sh asserts package.json keeps version from PR.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Multiple dependency updates touch generated lockfiles.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Lockfile follows the dependency bump carried by the PR.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: Lockfile side comes from PR; checks prove consistency.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Single lockfile conflict chain when several Dependabot PRs touch the same lockfile.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Keep PR-side bump, then rely on package-manager validation.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: pnpm lockfile remains aligned with the PR dependency update.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Generated dependency lockfile drift under dependency PR.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Keep PR-side generated lockfile for the bump.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: Yarn lockfile remains aligned with the PR dependency update.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Boot contract evolves while PR branches carry older operational law.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Current canonical law wins; do not duplicate boot or create V2.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: main boot remains authoritative and references the single registry/engine.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Entrypoint changes under many operational PRs.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Current entrypoint points to the owner; no giant duplicated table.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: LEIA-ME-IA keeps single-owner routing.
patterns.COUNTERPROOF: grep in integration test validates single registry reference.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Loop skill receives recurrent operational refinements.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Skill law comes from current main unless a reviewed owner update proves otherwise.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: No PR bot overwrites skill law without review.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Generated dist/source pair may drift during MCP tool edits.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Source governs; dist follows only when owner build contract requires it.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: Source file remains canonical from main during automated conflict resolution.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Generated dist file may conflict with source edits.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Dist is not source of truth; regenerate only under owner contract.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: Automated resolver does not promote stale generated artifact.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Casa/VPS bridge contract changes while runtime reconciliation PRs move.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Current main architecture wins; runtime claims require separate measurement.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: Architecture doc keeps current source-of-truth wording.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Operational discovery docs receive concurrent edits from reconciliation loops.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Learning promoted to main remains the canonical source until a reviewed delta supersedes it.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: No automated PR rewrites learning history silently.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Latest/changelog reports are updated by repeated sync passes.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Current report state on main wins unless a new sync receipt is proven.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: Reports remain consistent with current main receipts.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Operational channel discovery evolves during Casa/VPS reconciliation.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Scripts that discover runtime state must not be overwritten by dependency PRs.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: Current main discovery script remains intact.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Continuity validator is a high-touch canonical test.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Validator law comes from current main.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: Automated resolver preserves current validator behavior.
patterns.COUNTERPROOF: Integration test asserts registry covers this path.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Media transcript tooling may diverge between runtime and source.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Current source script wins; runtime installation follows deploy proof.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: Script remains aligned with main.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: IDE mode script receives recurrent operational edits.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Current main IDE operation script wins.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: No bot PR silently replaces IDE operational mode.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Wrapper script receives recurrent operational edits.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Current main wrapper wins.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: No bot PR silently replaces IDE wrapper behavior.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Gitlink existed in index without .gitmodules mapping, breaking checkout/submodule status.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Gitlink stays removed from source; local scratch directory is not canonical.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: No orphan submodule mapping error.
patterns.COUNTERPROOF: git submodule status returns RC 0 after 49d32ab.

patterns.KNOWN_CAUSE: Workflow is both trigger and guard for resolver; conflict markers previously broke main.
patterns.PRESERVE_RULE: Workflow security and single-engine routing follow current main.
patterns.EXPECTED_RESULT: Workflow continues to call the single resolver and avoids untrusted HEAD execution.
